paragraphs: Rav Yosef bar Abba, in Rav’s time. It seems to me it should read Rava’s time: Shemonah Sheratzim 108b has ‘Rava and Rav Yosef bar Abba both say,’ and I wrote in the principles that wherever it says ‘both say,’ he is his disputant. This requires examination, for he asked Rav Yehudah, and Rava was born when Rav Yehudah died. He also spoke in Rabbi Yochanan’s, Mar Ukva’s, and Rav Sheshet’s names; they preceded Rava, for Yosef bar Chama, Rava’s father, spoke in Rav Sheshet’s name. At any rate, he was not in Rav’s time. Rav Yosef bar Abba said: Rabbi Yochanan said, HaRoeh 59b, end. Rav Yosef bar Abba said: Rabbah bar Yirmeyah came to our place, Avodah Zarah 50a, end. Rav Yosef bar Abba said: Mar Ukva said: Shmuel said, Bava Batra 144b, end. Eruvin 7b: Rav Sheshet told Rav Yosef bar Abba, ‘I shall explain it to you.’ Bava Kamma 112b: Rav Sheshet told Rabbi Yose—it should read Yosef—bar Abbahu—it should read Abba—‘I shall explain Rabbi Yochanan’s reason.’ Bava Metzia 72b: Rav Yosef bar Chama told Rav Sheshet; some say Rav Yose—it should read Yosef—bar Abba told Rav Sheshet: ‘Did Rav Huna say thus?’ See Abba Yose ben Abba above [entry headed Abba Yose ben Abai]. Berakhot 11b, end: Rabbi Yose—it should read Yosef—bar Abba and Rabbi Abba asked Rav Mattanah and Rav Yehudah.
